bronze_scrap_remelting.observation: Broken axes and cracked cauldrons are sorted by color and ring, and each heap goes back into its own crucible.

glass_ingot_casting.observation: Blue glass is poured into round clay moulds, and the cakes travel by ship to workshops that cannot melt their own.

mandrel_wound_beads.observation: A thread of hot glass wound on a copper rod cools into a bead, and a practiced hand makes a hundred before noon.

bronze_toothed_saws.observation: A bronze blade filed into teeth cuts planks from a log that once took wedges and a day of splitting.

shellfish_purple_dye.observation: Heaps of crushed sea snails rot in vats by the shore, and the cloth that comes out is worth its weight in silver.
shellfish_purple_dye.social_consequence: The dye works make a few families rich and the whole shore stink; the color becomes a mark of rank.

inlay_carving.observation: Carvers set slivers of ivory and shell into a chair back until the wood hardly shows.

fine_linen_counts.observation: The finest linen holds so many threads to a finger's breadth that a folded sheet passes through a ring.

clay_tuyere_draft.observation: A clay nozzle set in the furnace wall carries the bellows' breath straight into the heart of the charcoal.

ore_roasting.observation: Ore is heaped on burning wood before the smelt, and the sour smoke that rises from it leaves the rock easier to reduce.

covered_charcoal_clamps.observation: Stacked logs are sealed under turf and earth, and the burner reads the color of the smoke for ten days.

bloomery_smelting.ability_reason: Iron ore is far commoner than copper and tin; a bloom can be won wherever ore, charcoal and a good blast meet.
bloomery_smelting.social_consequence: Iron frees smiths from the long tin trade, but every bloom eats a stack of charcoal and the woods around the smelters thin.
bloomery_smelting.production_contract: Finite workshop batches make Wrought Iron from iron ore and timber, using stone and clay. Each batch consumes its materials, fuel and finite work; learning grants no stock.

bloom_consolidation.observation: The spongy bloom is reheated and beaten on the anvil until the slag weeps out and solid iron remains.

smithing_tool_sets.observation: Every smithy now keeps its tongs, swages and punches on the wall in order, each shaped for a single task.

slag_tapping.observation: The smelter breaks the clay plug at the furnace foot and lets the glowing slag run out in a stream.

bloom_fracture_grading.observation: Each bloom is split cold: bright fine grain goes to blades, coarse grey grain to nails and hoops.

iron_farm_tools.observation: An iron share cuts sod that bent a bronze one, and the sickle keeps its edge through a whole harvest.
iron_farm_tools.ability_reason: Iron is cheap enough to put in every farmer's hand, not only the warrior's.

ash_lye_cleansers.observation: Water poured through wood ash comes out slippery and bitter, and it lifts grease from wool better than any clay.
ash_lye_cleansers.production_contract: Finite workshop batches make Wood-Ash Lye from timber and freshwater, using clay and timber. Each batch consumes its materials, fuel and finite work; learning grants no stock.

surface_carburization.production_contract: Iron edge tools are packed in sealed pots of charcoal and horn and held at a steady red heat, gaining a hard steel skin while the core stays tough. Each batch consumes metal, charcoal, fuel, tooling and finite work; the discovery grants no stock.

hardened_edges.ability_reason: A carburized edge plunged into water becomes hard enough to outcut bronze and hold its edge far longer.

edge_tempering.observation: The quenched blade is laid on hot ash until its polish turns straw-yellow, and then it bends instead of snapping.

piled_blade_welding.observation: Strips of soft and hard iron are stacked, welded and drawn out together into one tough blade.

forged_iron_nails.observation: A smith heads iron nails by the hundred in a nail plate, and the shipwright clenches them over iron washers.

iron_stone_chisels.observation: An iron point dresses hard granite that blunted three bronze chisels in a morning.

iron_files_rasps.observation: Iron files cut with fine teeth true a joint or sharpen a saw where a whetstone once took hours.

paired_bag_bellows.observation: Two goatskin bags worked in turn keep the blast from ever pausing, and the furnace holds its white heat.

tablet_weaving.observation: Square tablets threaded at their corners are turned together, and a patterned band grows as long as the warp.

glazed_relief_bricks.observation: Brightly glazed bricks, each moulded with part of a beast, fit together into a lion striding along the gate wall.

reduction_vat_blue_dye.observation: Leaves ferment in a warm vat until the liquor turns yellow, and cloth dipped in it comes out green and turns blue in the air.

spring_shears.observation: Iron shears that spring open by themselves clip a fleece whole where plucking once tore it.

pole_lathe_turning.observation: A cord from a springy pole wraps the work, and the treadle spins bowls and chair legs round and true.

fused_cane_glass.observation: Slices of colored glass rod are packed over a mould and slumped in the kiln into a bowl of flowers.

lead_sheet_rolling.observation: Refined lead is cast on a bed of sand and beaten into broad sheet for roofs, tank linings and pipes.
lead_sheet_rolling.production_contract: Refined lead is cast into flat sheets on a sanded bed and beaten thin. Each batch consumes refined lead, sand, fuel, tooling and finite work; the discovery grants no stock. Rolled electrode sheet comes later with lead-acid cells.

argentiferous_lead_working.observation: The miners follow the lead veins for the silver in them, and the smelting hearths leave the hillside grey and bare.
argentiferous_lead_working.social_consequence: Silver from lead ore fills the treasury, but the smelting smoke sickens the hearth crews and kills the hillside's trees.

die_struck_coinage.observation: Blanks of weighed silver are laid on an engraved anvil and struck with a punch, and each piece carries the city's badge.
die_struck_coinage.ability_reason: A struck coin carries its guaranteed weight on its face, so trade no longer stops at the scales.
die_struck_coinage.social_consequence: Coin lets strangers trade at a glance; whoever strikes it gains a hand in every bargain and the temptation to thin the silver.
die_struck_coinage.production_contract: Finite workshop batches make Struck Silver Coins from refined silver and charcoal, using wrought iron and stone. Each batch consumes its materials, fuel and finite work; learning grants no stock.

three_stage_gloss_firing.observation: The kiln is fired bright, then choked with green wood, then cleared again, and the pots come out red and glossy black.

knotted_pile_rugs.observation: Wool tufts knotted row by row around the warp make a rug thick enough to sleep on through a mountain winter.

decolorized_clear_glass.observation: A pinch of a dark mineral in the batch clears the green from the glass, and the cup shows the wine's true color.

moulded_terracotta_series.observation: Roof ornaments and votive figures are pressed from the same two-piece moulds, a hundred alike from each.

liquid_iron_furnaces.observation: A tall furnace blown hard runs iron out liquid at its foot, and it can be poured like bronze into moulds.
liquid_iron_furnaces.ability_reason: A taller shaft and a stronger blast carry iron past its melting point, so it can be cast instead of hammered.
liquid_iron_furnaces.social_consequence: Cast iron is cheap and brittle; the furnaces run day and night and want whole forests of charcoal.
liquid_iron_furnaces.production_contract: Finite workshop batches make Cast Iron from iron ore, charcoal and limestone, using refractory bricks and clay. Each batch consumes its materials, fuel and finite work; learning grants no stock.

stamped_capacity_amphorae.observation: Each transport jar is stamped at the handle with its potter and its measure, and merchants stop re-measuring the cargo.

vessel_tinning.observation: Copper cooking pots are wiped inside with molten tin, and the stew no longer tastes of green metal.
vessel_tinning.production_contract: Finite workshop batches make Tinned Copper Vessels from refined copper, refined tin and charcoal, using clay and stone. Each batch consumes its materials, fuel and finite work; learning grants no stock.

sloped_climbing_kilns.observation: The kiln climbs the hillside in a long tunnel, and the fire's heat rises through it to fire thousands of pots at once.

cast_iron_annealing.observation: Brittle cast plough tips are held red-hot for days in a sealed pit and come out able to take a blow.
cast_iron_annealing.production_contract: Finite workshop batches make Cast Iron Ploughshares from cast iron and charcoal, using refractory bricks and clay. Each batch consumes its materials, fuel and finite work; learning grants no stock.

gold_thread_embroidery.observation: Gold beaten thin and wound around a thread is couched onto a robe, and the wearer glitters at every step.

mercury_fire_gilding.observation: Gold dissolved in quicksilver is brushed onto bronze, and the fire drives off the poison vapor and leaves the gold behind.
mercury_fire_gilding.social_consequence: Gilders grow shaky and toothless young; the gold shines, and the vapor does its work on the men who fire it.

gem_cutting_wheel.observation: A spinning copper wheel fed with emery grit cuts facets and seal designs into stones too hard for any graver.

water_mills.ability_reason: A wheel in the stream turns the millstones all day and night, freeing the hands that ground grain every morning.

crucible_steel_cakes.observation: Iron and charred leaves sealed in clay pots are melted for a day, and the cakes forge into blades with a rippled sheen.
crucible_steel_cakes.ability_reason: Melting iron with carbon in a sealed pot gives an even, hard steel that no packing in charcoal can match.
crucible_steel_cakes.production_contract: Finite workshop batches make Steel from wrought iron and charcoal, using ceramic crucibles and refractory bricks; and Shaft Bearings from refined copper, steel and graphite, using steel and timber. Each batch consumes its materials, fuel and finite work; learning grants no stock.

resist_dyeing.observation: Patterns painted in wax stay pale when the cloth goes into the vat, and the wax is boiled off after.

mine_drainage_screws.observation: Men tread long wooden screws set in a chain up the gallery, and the water climbs from one to the next to the drain.

moulded_glass_gems.observation: Colored glass pressed into gem moulds turns out seal stones by the tray for buyers who cannot afford real ones.

drawloom_pattern_control.observation: A helper perched above the loom pulls the pattern cords in turn, and figured beasts march across the cloth.

treadle_frame_loom.observation: The weaver's feet work the heddles while both hands throw the shuttle, and cloth grows twice as fast.

lathe_ground_cast_glass.observation: Thick cast bowls are mounted on the lathe and ground with wet sand until the walls are thin and even.

cast_iron_vessels.observation: Iron poured into sand moulds gives cooking cauldrons and ploughshares by the hundred, cheap enough for villages.
cast_iron_vessels.production_contract: Finite workshop batches make Cast Iron Vessels from cast iron, prepared clay and charcoal, using refractory bricks and stone. Each batch consumes its materials, fuel and finite work; learning grants no stock.

fullers_earth_finishing.observation: Fullers tread the woven cloth in vats of water and white clay until it shrinks, thickens and sheds its grease.

cementation_brass.observation: Copper granules sealed in a crucible with a crushed pale ore and charcoal come out golden, and the mint strikes coins from them.
cementation_brass.production_contract: Finite workshop batches make Brass from refined copper, zinc ore and charcoal, using ceramic crucibles and refractory bricks. Each batch consumes its materials, fuel and finite work; learning grants no stock.

mechanical_screw_presses.observation: A cut wooden screw turned by a bar presses olives, grapes and folded cloth harder than any weighted beam.
mechanical_screw_presses.production_contract: Make a cut wooden screw and frame, then use the installed press on olive mash, grape pulp and folded cloth. Actual mash, cloth and work remain necessary; the press grants no stock.

lead_glazed_ware.observation: A lead glaze melts to a glassy green skin at low heat, and cheap jugs and lamps come out watertight and bright.

mould_stamped_gloss_ware.observation: Red tableware is thrown inside decorated moulds, and the same bowl is sold at every port on the sea.

glass_blowing.ability_reason: A breath through a pipe turns a gather into a vessel in minutes; glass becomes a household ware, not a jewel.

industrial_pottery_kilns.observation: The kiln yard fires tens of thousands of stamped bowls a season, and the hills around it are cut bare for fuel.
industrial_pottery_kilns.social_consequence: A few great kiln yards undersell every village potter, and the woods for a day's walk go to feed their fires.

layered_cameo_glass.observation: A white glass skin over dark blue is carved away like a gem, leaving white figures standing on a night-blue ground.

cast_window_glass.observation: Glass is poured and spread on a sanded table into small greenish panes, dim but enough to light a bath house.
cast_window_glass.production_contract: Finite workshop batches make Window Glass from glass, timber and fine sand, using refractory bricks and stone. Each batch consumes its materials, fuel and finite work; learning grants no stock.

water_driven_bellows.observation: A water wheel works the bellows day and night, and the furnace no longer waits on tired arms.

iron_bladed_planes.observation: An iron blade wedged in a wooden stock shaves a board flat and true that an adze could only rough out.

two_beam_upright_loom.observation: With a beam at top and bottom the weaver sits and rolls the cloth down, and a single web can be as wide as a room.

lead_backed_glass_mirrors.observation: Hot lead poured into a thin glass bubble backs it with silver-grey, and a small round mirror shows a whole face.
lead_backed_glass_mirrors.production_contract: Finite workshop batches make Glass Mirrors from glass, refined lead and charcoal, using clay and stone. Each batch consumes its materials, fuel and finite work; learning grants no stock.

steel_edge_inlaying.observation: A thin strip of steel is welded into the edge of an iron axe, so the whole head need not be costly steel.

high_fire_stoneware.observation: Fired hotter than any pot before it, the grey body rings like a bell and holds brine and wine without a lead glaze.
high_fire_stoneware.ability_reason: A kiln hot enough to half-melt the clay gives vessels that need no glaze to hold liquid and never taint food.

textile_rag_pulping.production_contract: Worn plant-fiber cloth is sorted, cut, soaked and beaten back into pulp in a workshop with paid tooling, water and work. Learning creates neither pulp, paper nor free research.

paper_making.ability_reason: Sheets formed from beaten fiber are lighter and cheaper than skins or tablets, so writing can go wherever a courier can carry it.
paper_making.production_contract: Finite workshop batches make Paper from paper pulp and freshwater, using timber and fiber plants. Each batch consumes its materials, fuel and finite work; learning grants no stock.

water_powered_stone_saws.observation: A mill wheel drives a pair of toothless iron blades back and forth, and sand and water cut the marble into slabs.

annealing_chamber_furnaces.observation: Fresh glass is carried into a warm side chamber and left to cool overnight, and far fewer pieces crack on the shelf.

pattern_welded_blades.observation: Twisted rods of iron and steel are welded side by side and ground bright, and the blade shows a pattern like running water.

pewter_casting.observation: Tin with a little lead is poured into stone moulds, giving plates and cups that shine like silver at a tenth of the cost.
pewter_casting.production_contract: Finite workshop batches make Pewter Ware from refined tin, refined lead and charcoal, using stone and clay. Each batch consumes its materials, fuel and finite work; learning grants no stock.

gold_glass_tesserae.observation: Gold leaf sealed between two layers of glass is cut into small cubes, and a whole apse glows with them.

champleve_enamel.observation: Hollows cut in a bronze brooch are filled with powdered glass and fired until the colors fuse in place.

weft_faced_compound_weave.observation: Hidden warps bind two colors of weft, and the pattern stands clear on both faces of the heavy cloth.

alembic_distillation.observation: Vapor rising from the heated flask cools in the still-head and runs down its spout into a separate vessel.
alembic_distillation.ability_reason: A still separates what boils easily from what does not, giving purer waters, oils and medicines.
alembic_distillation.production_contract: Finite workshop batches make Laboratory Glassware from glass vessels, glass and timber, using wrought iron, clay and stone. Each batch consumes its materials, fuel and finite work; learning grants no stock.

salted_hard_soap.observation: Salt thrown into the boiling lye and fat brings up a hard cake of soap that keeps and travels.
salted_hard_soap.production_contract: Finite workshop batches make Laundry Soap from rendered animal fat, wood-ash lye, salt and freshwater, using clay and stone. Each batch consumes its materials, fuel and finite work; learning grants no stock.

blown_cylinder_panes.observation: A long bubble of glass is blown, slit along its side and flattened in the kiln into a clear sheet.
blown_cylinder_panes.ability_reason: Opening a blown cylinder gives larger, thinner and clearer panes than glass poured on a table.
blown_cylinder_panes.production_contract: Finite workshop batches make Window Glass from glass and timber, using wrought iron, refractory bricks and clay. Each batch consumes its materials, fuel and finite work; learning grants no stock.
